claims.summary: A fresh deployed v0.15.28 EduTool.dev Sociology audit proved source reports now ship, but exposed polluted proof where SOURCE_REPORT.md listed package labels and generic placeholders as source rows.
Course Map and syllabus resource fallbacks pass through a source-candidate guard before becoming normalized source-ledger rows.
Package labels and placeholder resource sentences are rejected instead of exported as fake citation rows.
Real fallback receipts with provider hints, URLs, DOI values, licenses, or recognizable academic/OER source signals continue to export.
Absent source proof remains a source-proof problem instead of being hidden behind fabricated fallback rows, with focused regressions pinning the audited failure class.

carryForward.next: Build a real ResearchSession planner that researches course concepts once, caches a trusted ledger, and compiles many deliverables without browsing per artifact.
Add semantic claim support checks for high-risk factual anchors using cached snippets or quote anchors.
Run a fresh deployed audit after v0.15.29 and confirm packages export real source rows, not fallback placeholders, with no hidden source-proof caveats.
